intakeDuration.note: Crank degrees, measured with the intake cam phaser OFF (fully retarded). Nissan's letters: a = exhaust duration, b = intake duration, c = intake opens BTDC (-6, i.e. 6 deg ATDC), d = intake closes ABDC (64), e = exhaust closes ATDC (8), f = exhaust opens BBDC (52); c + 180 + d = 238 and f + 180 + e = 240 check. The lift at which duration is measured is not stated.
